steps.title: Week 1 - Plumbing Basics and Tools
steps.description: Record practical activities for introduction to plumbing trade, safety and PPE, plumbing tools, pipe types and sizes, basic marking and measurement, and basic pipe fittings.

steps.title: Week 2 - Pipe Fitting and Water Supply
steps.description: Record practicals for GI/PVC/CPVC pipe practice, threading and solvent joints, valves and taps, water supply layout, and leakage checking.

steps.title: Week 3 - Sanitary and Drainage Systems
steps.description: Record installation practicals for sanitary fixtures, wash basin and WC installation basics, sink and health faucet, traps and waste pipes, drainage layout and slope practice.

steps.title: Week 4 - Final Practical and Testing
steps.description: Record final practical activities including complete water supply and drainage connection, fixture alignment, pressure testing, leak testing, and final practical job task assessment.

steps.title: Final Assessment
steps.description: Record a 2-minute final practical assessment. Your trainer will watch this video with all pathway videos, then unlock your certificate download and QR.
